channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Are global oil reserves sufficient to withstand renewed US-Iran war?
item.description: With emergency stocks at multidecade lows, analysts say the world may have only a month or two if Hormuz shuts again.

item.title: EU entering winter with lowest gas reserves on record, IEA boss warns
item.description: Al Jazeera interviews Fatih Birol in Berlin as the Iran war disrupts global energy supplies.

item.title: Five Israelis wounded and two suspected Palestinian attackers killed in West Bank shooting
item.description: The attack comes at a time of heightened tensions in the West Bank and four days before Israel's general election.

item.title: Newborn twins fight for survival as conflict fuels Yemen's hunger crisis
item.description: Raghad and Raad's family had to flee their home on foot because of the fighting between pro-government forces and the Houthis.

item.title: At least four dead after storm brings flooding to southern France
item.description: The deaths include two women found drowned in a cellar in the Bouches-du-Rhône region.

item.title: How Arab parties could hold critical balance of power in Israeli election
item.description: Disaffection has often driven down turnout among Arab Israelis, but there is a strong push to get rid of the right-wing governing coalition.
